qualification: negative local production-admission evidence; not correctness, performance, hardware, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

candidateAdmission.boundedRule: The candidate admitted only the complete one-instruction, one-statement block at 0xffffffff815cab95 with the measured five-byte memory SETE operation.
candidateAdmission.implementation: Materialize pending flags, stage the equality predicate, then perform one final transactional byte write; a failed write publishes neither architectural state nor memory.
candidateAdmission.withdrawal: The exact production admission was reverted after the pinned full workload reproduced the NX init-text panic. The measured site remains deferred.

verificationBeforeProduction.dbtAndPCGate: 1,442 tests in 171 suites passed; the pinned PVH environment test skipped because its environment variables were absent
verificationBeforeProduction.differentialCoverage: True and false equality outcomes matched the interpreter at the measured high-canonical block; the same operation at an adjacent RIP declined.
verificationBeforeProduction.rollbackCoverage: A failed transactional byte write preserved the original architectural state and memory.
verificationBeforeProduction.additionalDiagnostic: A local CMP-to-branch-to-measured-SETE differential carried pending lazy flags through a chained boundary and also passed.
verificationBeforeProduction.interpretation: The passing local differentials were insufficient to establish safe production admission.

failure.type: supervisor instruction fetch from an NX-protected init-text page
failure.context: A timer interrupt arrived while free_init_pages was reaching set_memory_nx; the fatal exception in interrupt reset the guest before it emitted an authenticated receipt.
failure.signature: The address and free_init_pages/set_memory_nx call path match the earlier rejected broad memory-ALU and byte-XOR production admissions.

verificationAfterWithdrawal.dbtAndPCGate: 1,441 tests in 171 suites passed after reverting the candidate; the pinned PVH environment test skipped because its environment variables were absent
verificationAfterWithdrawal.knownGoodState: The source tree again contains the bounded byte-XOR admission and no memory-SETcc tier-one admission.

interpretation: The exact-site memory SETE candidate passed focused and aggregate differentials but failed the pinned production workload with a repeatable NX init-text signature. This does not prove that memory SETcc is generally incorrect; it proves that this production admission remains unsafe or unexplained under the current transition and interrupt model. The implementation was withdrawn, the known-good aggregate gate is green, and the site remains deferred.
limitations: The failure was observed in one local pinned-fixture production run, but its signature matches two earlier rejected admission experiments.
The raw diagnostic remains a local build artifact and is not committed because it includes host-local paths and a large console transcript.
No causal mechanism has yet been isolated between this exact admission and the later init-text execution fault.
This rejected record supports neither a correctness claim nor a performance comparison.
